findings.claim: No document defines a player contract for Epoch 1: what the player is trying to achieve, what verbs act on a thread, how they know they are winning, what an epoch-end evaluation shows, or what failure looks like. 'Leverage Chain' is named but never defined.
findings.rec: Write a one-page Epoch 1 player contract before change 06: in-fiction mission, player verbs per thread, 3-4 readable measures, end trigger, epoch-end evaluation as the ledger diff (not a single score), and two fail/partial outcomes that carry forward as scars.

findings.claim: The design has no player-facing feedback loop for covert actions: discovery layers, pressure stocks and persecution risk are simulation state, HUD readouts are explicitly banned, and no surface is specified that tells the player an action worked, was noticed, or backfired.
findings.rec: Assign feedback duties to the advisors (Ship Mind delayed statistical debrief; Drone bodily/room reading) and give every WorldEffect a player-readable cause surfaced after its delay; prototype on the 2-room slice with one fake delayed effect.

findings.claim: Roadmap sequencing defers every test of the core fantasy: the first content pack (first office/behavior/thread) is change 11 of 27; the first decision-with-consequence is 07b/07c; utility AI (06), regard (06a), pacing (05b), audio (05a), ONNX (08), orbital (09) and epoch transition (10) are all specified and built against an empty world; writing quality is first tested by a banned-lemma fixture (07e), not a human read.
findings.rec: Insert a thin vertical-slice change right after 05d/05e and before 05a/05b/06: one thread, one office/pretext, 3 authored NPCs, one Space-driven choice with a visible delayed consequence, an end card showing the ledger. Play it with a friend; revise the loop doc from what they do. Add a 'validated by' column to the roadmap.

findings.claim: The minute-to-minute and session loops cannot be reconstructed from the docs; embodied talking costs no campaign time ('Reading costs no watch') and the time-spend actions are listed as nouns, so nothing makes the player choose between talking and acting.
findings.rec: Write the loop as three stated cycles (minute / session / epoch) and introduce an attention budget (limited NPC access per watch) so conversation competes with time-spend.

findings.claim: There is no bridge between the watch clock and the room: no NPC presence/schedule model says where bodies are after watches pass, NPC chains stop at 2 hops until the player acts, and the two halves of agency (Clock 1 embodied, Clock 2 macro levers) are coupled only by generic WorldEffects.
findings.rec: Specify a per-character watch-of-day presence table resolved on room entry (Clock 2 decides where bodies are, Clock 1 animates them), and declare that every macro lever is exercised through a person or place the player physically reaches.

findings.claim: The design depends on hidden information the player must remember (romantic motives, rival tells, deleted rumor slots) but has no player knowledge/notebook system and no save/reload policy.
findings.rec: Make the lace log the player's notebook (auto-recorded, diffable overview states and conversation chunks) and decide save policy now.

findings.claim: The writing pipeline contradicts itself: config describes a runtime 'Period-Voice Composer' generating replies, DESIGN_NOTES says the words are authored and the engine does not invent them, storylets use a slot grammar, and the specificity bar is hand-authored character detail.
findings.rec: Decide: free text selects among authored reply nodes (intent -> node) and remove 'Composer', or cut free text. Prefer quality-gated authored storylet cards over slot grammar.

findings.claim: The emotional spine contradicts itself: the Drone's Regard toward the player decides assassination survival and the advisors are the main characters, yet the operative is replaced each epoch and the advisors' personality traits and the Drone's identity are re-rolled per epoch.
findings.rec: Keep the Ship Mind and Drone as one persistent pair for the campaign (only the disguise varies per epoch), with advisor regard carried forward as lineage-level trust.

findings.claim: Shipped schemas encode unvalidated design numbers and enums (3 instruments, 3 pressure stocks, 5 pillars, 4 discovery layers, 3 orbital phases), ~1.9k lines of registry/schema/reducer/legacy code serve 3 content entries, and rework is already queued: 8 *Tick fields in EpochBlueprints.ts are to be rebased onto Watches in 05b.
findings.rec: Mark unused kinds/effects provisional (or move to a draft area), add no new consumers until the vertical slice uses them, settle the clock model before any further time-bearing schema, and extract abstractions at second use.

findings.claim: Several systems lack a documented input or consumer: pressure stocks have no reader beyond a travel cue and a transition bonus; fund acquisition is deferred with no acquisition rule; threads have no stated player lever.
findings.rec: Draw a one-page system graph (who writes / who reads each node) and defer any node missing an arrow.

findings.claim: The design specifies mechanisms far more than experiences: no first-10-minutes/onboarding design exists, and threads, romance channels, assassination vectors and contingencies are enumerated without stating the intended player moment or feeling.
findings.rec: Script the opening 10 minutes as content, and write a 5-line best-case play story per thread to use as acceptance scenarios.

findings.claim: The Culture tone sits mostly as flavor over exposure mechanics: nearly every player cost is self-protective (cover, discovery, persecution) rather than ethical; the one ethical cost is a Drone Regard drop.
findings.rec: Show the Integral's expected-lives figure and the Particular's named-person cost on major choices and let them diverge.

findings.claim: The epoch handoff has data hooks (legacy state, predecessor traces) but no specified player-facing payoff showing what the previous operative changed.
findings.rec: Treat the next epoch's opening as the payoff: a guided walk through what changed, naming specific Epoch 1 people.

findings.claim: Built subsystems are inert or will be contradicted: cognitive scheduler pulses over zero behaviors, legacy export/save never called, browser telemetry cannot meet the 'must log to ./logs' rule, click-to-waypoint is to be replaced by WASD.
findings.rec: Label click/waypoint as dev tooling; wire browser telemetry to /api/telemetry or amend the rule to match reality.

routes.title: One-thread vertical slice first
routes.proposal: Before 05a/05b/06, hand-author one thread (e.g. Sorrel/Pell) end to end: 3 rooms, 3-8 people, one office pretext, Space-driven choices, a visible delayed consequence and an end card with the ledger diff. Play with friends, then generalize.

routes.title: Advisors are the feedback channel and the ethics
routes.proposal: The Ship Mind gives a delayed per-watch statistical debrief; the Drone reports the bodily/room truth; their disagreement is the readout of success/notice/backfire, and major choices show both the expected-lives and the named-person cost.

routes.title: Lace log as notebook / evidence board
routes.proposal: The Ship Mind auto-records overview states, conversation chunks and briefings; the player can diff them; omitted clauses appear as gaps; optionally a diegetic string board in Chambers shows which acts were noticed and by whom.

routes.title: Content-first, extract abstractions later
routes.proposal: Quarantine registry kinds/effects with no content behind a draft area; author Epoch 1 as plain typed data; promote to the epoch-agnostic registry only when a second use exists. Keep lineageId as the forward hook.

routes.title: Text-only advisor/writing prototype
routes.proposal: Before engine work on dialogue/NLP, test the writing and the advisory-duel idea as a plain text page: two conflicting briefings on a hand-authored scenario, the player picks.

routes.title: Seasonal council macro loop; rooms as scenes
routes.proposal: Make the watch clock the primary loop: each season a few verb slots (court, write, study, travel) with advisor advice; rooms are entered when a storylet or office case needs embodiment rather than as free roam (King of Dragon Pass style).

routes.title: Quality-based storylet decks
routes.proposal: Replace slot-grammar storylets with authored cards gated by qualities (stocks, regard, discovery layer, office); slots only for names/places (Sunless Sea / StoryNexus).

routes.title: Epoch as cartridge
routes.proposal: Each epoch is a complete game with its own ending screen; Epoch 1 is a standalone 3-5 hour scenario; later epochs import the ledger like a sequel.

routes.title: CK3-style scheme odds
routes.proposal: Show success %, secrecy and a breakdown of Regard modifiers on every scheme, pretext spend and letter.
